target.title: fix: gateway boots when a configured plugin payload is broken
target.body:
Refs #109833

PR #110200 has merged into `main`; this branch is rebased onto its merge result.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where gateway readiness was blocked when a configured and enabled plugin package failed startup verification, even though the failure belonged to a known plugin surface that could be isolated.

## Why This Change Was Made

This implements the operator decision on #109833: degrade and boot. Startup quarantines the known plugin owner, emits its typed verification diagnostic once, and skips that plugin before any plugin code can load. Doctor, status, and health expose every quarantined plugin as `configured-unavailable`.

The behavior mirrors degraded SecretRef owners in `src/secrets/runtime-degraded-state.ts` and configured-unavailable channels in `src/channels/status/read-model.ts`. It also follows the root `AGENTS.md` security policy that failures isolate to the smallest known owning surface. The explicit `openclaw update` convergence path remains unchanged and continues to report payload convergence failures prominently.

## User Impact

Operators can keep the gateway ready when one configured plugin package is broken, while the broken plugin remains fully unavailable for that boot and its typed reason stays visible in operational diagnostics. State-migration failures, structurally invalid config, and startup failures with unknown ownership still block readiness.

## Summary

- Records enabled-plugin verification failures as a boot-stable quarantine snapshot refreshed on every Gateway process start.
- Prevents quarantined plugins from reaching artifact resolution or import.
- Keeps package-scoped peer-link inspection failures attached to known plugin ownership; inactive known packages do not block, while genuinely unowned failures remain blockers.
- Projects degraded state through doctor, status, and health, with install paths redacted from public diagnostics.
- Retains the quarantine diagnostic in registry/health state while emitting that exact typed finding only once during startup.

## Root Cause

Before this change, `src/commands/doctor-config-preflight.ts` converted every plugin convergence warning into a fatal startup diagnostic. The design contract in `src/cli/update-cli/post-core-plugin-convergence.ts` explicitly required refusing restart whenever an active installed plugin payload was unloadable, so a known plugin-owned package failure blocked the entire gateway.

Real EACCES proof also exposed two adjacent causes that unit-only proof had missed:

- managed npm peer-link inspection read the same unreadable `package.json` first and converted that known package failure into an ownerless blocking warning;
- the startup migration checkpoint skipped plugin convergence on later processes, so a process-local quarantine could disappear on the second boot while the payload was still broken.

The fix preserves package ownership through peer inspection, refreshes plugin availability on every process start while leaving one-time state migrations checkpointed, and suppresses only the exact loader diagnostic already emitted by startup preflight. PR #110200 supplies the typed package-verification reasons, including unreadable `package.json`; this PR changes only the Gateway readiness policy for known plugin owners.

## Real behavior proof

Built-CLI local process proof on Linux with Node 25.9.0. The fixture is a packed npm plugin with `activation.onStartup: true`; its `register()` writes a sentinel and registers `proof-degrade.ping`. It was installed and enabled through the built CLI in an isolated temporary `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, then its installed `package.json` was changed to mode `000`. A direct same-user Node read returned `EACCES`.

Baseline was built from merge-base/main `03d5d88a14e4`; after proof was built from branch head `9ac87a5d7ba`. Paths below are redacted.

```text
BASELINE (03d5d88a14e4)
gateway_rc=1
readyz_rc=7
plugin_register_marker=absent
[openclaw] Reason: OpenClaw plugin verification failed; refusing to report the gateway ready.
- Failed to repair managed npm OpenClaw host peer links: EACCES: permission denied, open '<PROOF_ROOT>/state/npm/projects/.../package.json'
- Plugin "proof-degrade-plugin" failed post-core payload smoke check (unreadable-package-json): ... EACCES ...
```

```text
THIS BRANCH, broken payload (9ac87a5d7ba)
ready=yes status_rc=0 health_rc=0 doctor_rc=0
plugin_register_marker=absent
typed_startup_diagnostic_count=1
GET /readyz -> {"ready":true,"failing":[]}

status.degradedPlugins = [{
  "pluginId":"proof-degrade-plugin",
  "state":"configured-unavailable",
  "diagnostic":{"kind":"plugin-verification","reason":"unreadable-package-json",
    "detail":"Could not read package.json at <plugin-install>/package.json: EACCES ..."}
}]

health.plugins = {
  "loaded_contains_proof_plugin": false,
  "unavailable": [{"id":"proof-degrade-plugin","state":"configured-unavailable", ...}]
}

doctor:
Plugins configured unavailable
- proof-degrade-plugin (unreadable-package-json): Could not read package.json at <plugin-install>/package.json: EACCES ...
```

```text
SECOND STARTUP, same chmod 000 payload
ready=yes status_rc=0
plugin_register_marker=absent
typed_startup_diagnostic_count=1
GET /readyz -> {"ready":true,"failing":[]}
status.degradedPlugins -> proof-degrade-plugin / configured-unavailable / unreadable-package-json
```

```text
RECOVERY, after chmod 0644 only
ready=yes status_rc=0 health_rc=0 plugin_rpc_rc=0
plugin_register_marker=present
typed_startup_diagnostic_count=0
status.degradedPlugins=[]
health.plugins.loaded_contains_proof_plugin=true
health.plugins.unavailable=[]
gateway call proof-degrade.ping -> {"ok":true}
```

```text
UNCHANGED INVALID-CONFIG BLOCK
gateway_rc=78
readyz_rc=7
Gateway failed to start: Invalid config at <PROOF_ROOT>/invalid-openclaw.json:
gateway.port: Invalid input: expected number, received string
```

All temporary Gateway processes were stopped and the isolated proof state was removed after the PR body update was verified.

## Evidence

Focused quarantine, preflight, peer inspection, doctor, status, health, Gateway, and explicit update-path coverage on the final head:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/commands/doctor-config-preflight.state-migration.test.ts \
  src/cli/update-cli/post-core-plugin-convergence.test.ts \
  src/commands/doctor-plugin-registry.test.ts \
  src/plugins/plugin-peer-link.test.ts \
  src/gateway/server-startup-plugin-quarantine.test.ts \
  src/gateway/server-plugins.test.ts \
  src/commands/doctor-gateway-health.test.ts \
  src/commands/status.summary.test.ts \
  src/commands/status-overview-rows.test.ts \
  src/cli/update-cli.test.ts

Test Files  10 passed (10)
Tests       366 passed (366)
5 Vitest shards passed
```

## Verification

- `pnpm build` — passed for merge-base baseline and exact final branch head
- `pnpm format <touched paths>` — passed
- `pnpm tsgo:core` — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed
- `$autoreview --mode uncommitted` — accepted findings were fixed; final passes clean with no actionable findings

## What was not tested

- This was local built-CLI and local Gateway process proof; no container was used.
- No live channel/provider traffic or cross-platform scenario was run. The exercised surfaces were package verification, startup/readiness, plugin import/registration, status, health, doctor, recovery, and invalid-config blocking.
